_readme: The few things a PDF can't tell the site about itself. Everything else
(title, description, tags, outcomes, domain, location, highlights) is read
from the PDF's own text on every build.
clients          filename prefix -> client name shown on the site and used
as the Client filter. The longest matching prefix wins.
Files starting with 'confidential' are NDA cases.
tag_aliases      spelling in a PDF -> spelling on the site, so one tag
never shows up twice in the filters.
technology_tags  PDF tags that go in the Technology filter. Every other
tag goes in the Services filter.
industry_aliases same, for the Domain / Industry values.
files            per-file corrections, keyed by the PDF filename.
Fields: title, client, description, tags, industries,
locations, hidden (true = leave off the site),
